name: EID Parry India Ltd
title: EID Parry India Ltd - 500125 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Refinery (PSRIPL) shut after Q4 loss of Rs 293 cr; parent infused ~Rs 600 cr to clear loans by 30 June 2026, while Karnataka sugar stays the core profit engine and dividends remain unresolved.

utilisation.quote: we produced about 452 lakhs liters (LL) during the quarter, as against 438 LL of the corresponding quarter of the previous year

capex.quote: There are no other CAPEX plans. I think it is just given the industry situation, given perhaps the more macroeconomic situation, I think we will hunker down and run for cost and efficiency

triggers.label: Refinery shut; loans cleared by June
triggers.quote: all the loans obligations of PSRIPL will get completed by 30th June 2026
triggers.highlight: all the loans obligations of PSRIPL will get completed by 30th June 2026

triggers.label: Capex limited to Rs 45 cr jaggery plant
triggers.quote: The only CAPEX that we are doing this year is largely the new Jaggery facility. That is about a 45-odd crore CAPEX

triggers.label: Sugar realisation flat YoY at Rs 39.28
triggers.quote: for the current quarter, it is Rs. 39.28, as against, Rs. 39.22 of the corresponding quarter

triggers.label: Distillery realisation down 4%
triggers.quote: the average realization is at Rs. 64.25 for the current quarter, as against the Rs. 66.98

triggers.label: CPG revenue down 48% YoY
triggers.quote: The consumer product group has achieved a turnover of Rs. 115 crores during Q4, as against 195 crores

guidance.value: breakeven within 6-8 quarters; single-digit EBITDA by end of decade
guidance.quote: The intent is to break even within the next 6-8 quarters and exit this decade with a good single-digit percentage EBITDA on this business.

guidance.value: 16 crore litres moving toward 17 crore litres
guidance.quote: We would probably tend towards 17 crore liters if there is an improvement in ethanol blending percentage.

red_flags.label: Dividend timing unclear
red_flags.quote: I can't really give you any timelines on this.

red_flags.label: Parent funding subsidiary loans
red_flags.quote: EID has infused so far by 15th May was about Rs.600 crores into the payment obligations of the PSRIPL.

evasions.quote: I can't really give you any timelines on this.
this is not something which I would like to comment on here.
